description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController which provides several endpoints including welcome, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for greeting, API documentation, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message at the root endpoint.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI, preserving the original scheme, host, and port based on the incoming HTTP request.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
